name: Damaged Hair
description: Hair that has been compromised in structure and appearance due to various external factors such as chemical treatments, thermal styling, physical damage from tools or harsh brushes, and environmental stressors.
hair_texture: Can vary widely; can be dry, brittle, frizzy, or have a mix of textures
porosity: Highly porous, meaning the cuticles are lifted and more open, leading to faster absorption of moisture but also easier loss of moisture
characteristics: Increased dryness and lack of shine
common_problems: Hair that is prone to tangling
recommended_ingredients: Proteins (such as keratin or silk proteins)
recommended_product_categories: Intensive serums with high concentrations of active ingredients
washing_frequency: Every 2-3 days, or as needed to avoid excessive oiliness while keeping hair clean
oil_recommendation: Use light oils that are easily absorbed and do not weigh down the hair

morning_routine.action: Apply a leave-in conditioner or lightweight serum
morning_routine.purpose: To hydrate and protect the hair from daily stressors

night_routine.action: Deep condition or use a overnight treatment
night_routine.purpose: To repair and nourish damaged strands while they are at rest

weekly_care: Use a protein treatment to strengthen the hair structure
deep_conditioning_frequency: Once a week, for at least 30 minutes
heat_styling_recommendation: Minimize heat styling or use heat protectants and limit heat exposure time
lifestyle_tips: Avoid excessive brushing of wet hair to prevent breakage
foods_for_healthy_hair: Fatty acids from avocados and nuts
Iron and vitamin C from leafy greens to aid in absorption
common_mistakes: Using harsh chemicals or products without considering compatibility
Frequent use of heat styling tools without protection
do: Protect hair from environmental damage with hats and scarves
Stay hydrated to maintain overall health, which reflects in the condition of your hair
dont: Roughly handle hair when wet or dry
Overuse heat styling tools without protection
Skip regular moisturizing and deep conditioning treatments

seasonal_care.summer: Use lighter products and protect from sun damage with hats or UV-protectant sprays
seasonal_care.winter: Increase moisture intake to counter dry, cold air, and use more hydrating products
seasonal_care.monsoon: Keep hair dry to prevent fungal infections; use antifungal shampoos if necessary

compatible_hair_types: Normal Hair (can handle a bit of damage)
expert_tips: Consult with a dermatologist or trichologist for personalized recommendations and treatment plans
Be patient; repairing damaged hair takes time and consistent care
